## Checklist

- [ ] Runs entirely client-side — no server calls, no data collection
- [ ] Logic lives in a pure `engine.ts` with unit tests (for tool changes)
- [ ] Built from shared design-system components; no hardcoded design tokens
- [ ] Matches the neo-brutalist design language and the `ux-copy` voice
- [ ] Accessible: keyboard, visible focus, AA contrast, `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` all pass
- [ ] No dead code, `console.log`, unused imports, or emoji
- [ ] Ran the pre-commit checklist
